title: Dialectica Highlights 32,000+ Training Hours and Global Academic Partnerships on World Education Day 2026
summary: On World Education Day 2026, Dialectica showcased its 2025 'Educational Paths' initiatives including 32,000+ employee training hours, global academic partnerships, and continuous learning programs. The company emphasized that staying ahead in information services requires both the right technology and a growth mindset across its 1,400+ person team.
